dds_borvis_100.m: Journey to the south of Stoutford, into the forests there. See what that Shadow priest is doing there, and stop him from doing it.

dds_borvis_150.m: Ah, you're back!  Don't tell me you have defeated the renegade priest already? Not that I detected any change in the Shadow energies, which are in turmoil.
r: There's some sort of force shield blocking the path.
I found some stones with strange markings on them.

dds_borvis_154.m: With strange markings? Hmm. Show me.
r: I don't have any of these stones.

dds_borvis_156.m: No? You didn't think of the obvious idea that I should see them?
r: Unfortunately the stones could not be picked up or moved - as if they had some kind of energy in them.

dds_borvis_160.m: That sounds like a Shadow shield! Used to protect our incantations from outside interference, like those Feygard interferers.
r: But can't it recognize I am Shadow warrior, as you say, and let me pass?
But of course it would let you pass, wouldn't it?

dds_borvis_170.m: Kid, the world is more complex than you might think with that small brain of yours.

dds_borvis_172.m: A Shadow shield is a very basic shield, even if strong. It keeps everyone out after it is cast.

dds_borvis_174.m: Those small stones are shadow wards. They need to be neutralized

dds_borvis_180.m: Let me conjure a chant. I'll need some Shadow energies for that.

dds_borvis_181.m: Sorry. Of course you can't have knowledge of such things.

dds_borvis_182.m: Shadow priests can create and give energies in form of blessings to one.

dds_borvis_184.m: You need get and carry those energies to me. I'll use them to create a chant to take down the Shadow shield.
r: OK. Now what exactly do I ask for? And from whom?

dds_borvis_190.m: You'll need to get me the blessings of Shadow's Strength, Shadow Sleepiness, Fatigue and Life Drain. Through yourself.

dds_borvis_20.m: A very polite kid! Plus, as the Shadow has been whispering to me, a helpful one.

dds_borvis_200.m: This is the only way! Now, be a Shadow warrior! Go fetch them.

dds_borvis_210.m: Go to my friend Talion in Loneford. He'll give you the blessing of Shadow's Strength.

dds_borvis_212.m: Also he can tell you where to find the others.

dds_borvis_22.m: Listen, do you want help the Shadow?
r: That depends on what you want me to do.

dds_borvis_250.m: It took you a while. I thought you had given up.
r: [panting] Here are your energies, Borvis. I'm exhausted!

dds_borvis_260.m: Great! Let me quickly extract them from you.

dds_borvis_267.m: You didn't get them all! Go get the missing ones right now!

dds_borvis_270.m: Borvis did many obscure things, chanting all the way. But you were too tired to follow and dozed.

dds_borvis_272.m: Suddenly you wake up, completely refreshed.
r: Ah! I feel like I could tear down trees!

dds_borvis_280.m: While you slept I've prepared a tiny chant that nevertheless will destroy the Shadow shield. Here, read it.

dds_borvis_290.m: Go now and destroy the shield, and then the renegade priest. Make haste!

dds_borvis_40.m: Listen carefully - you have met many of us Shadow priests across Dhayavar. But, not all of us are equal.
r: You mean, there are priests more powerful than you?

dds_borvis_5.m: Begone, you Feygard lackey! I refuse to talk to you! You reek of Feygard!

dds_borvis_50.m: Er ... well ... not exactly what I mean.

dds_borvis_500.m: It's not done yet. Can you talk to this priest? And tackle him as he deserves?

dds_borvis_502.m: You'll be faster. Don't worry, I'll follow you.

dds_borvis_52.m: What I mean is this: there seems to be a priest who thinks the Shadow calls for the conquest of Dhayavar!

dds_borvis_540.m: The monster is not dead. Go and finish it!

r: Yes? Hope it is worth it.

dds_borvis_570.m: You are still looking for your brother?

dds_borvis_580.m: I know where he is. Or better, where he will be soon.

dds_borvis_590.m: Andor is going to visit Alynndir to refill his travel supplies.

dds_borvis_592.m: Alynndir lives in a lonely house down the road to Nor City. Don't you know?

dds_borvis_60.m: And I need your help to stop him!
r: Why? You can't take him on? Not powerful enough?

dds_borvis_7.m: You have betrayed our work by telling the truth about Beer Bootlegging from Sullengard. At least you did the right thing when you provided the Feygardians with bad weapons. So I'll let it go this time.

dds_borvis_70.m: No! Not that! To stop him, one needs a Shadow warrior, like you!
r: Me a Shadow warrior! OK, what do I need to do?

dds_borvis_8.m: You have betrayed our work by providing the Feygardians with weapons. At least you did the right thing when you didn't tell the truth about the Beer Bootlegging from Sullengard. So I'll let it go this time.

dds_borvis_82.m: Now, in the wasteland south of Stoutford, there have been reports of some suspicious activities.

dds_borvis_84.m: I fear it is my fellow priest summoning monsters to conquer all of Dhayavar. If it is not stopped, we might see lots of really unstoppable monsters popping up all over Dhayavar.

dds_borvis_90.m: Brave - but only few in Dhayavar have the skills to go toe-to-toe against these monsters.

dds_borvis_92.m: We must stop them at the source.
r: Yes, but what can we do?

dds_dark_priest2_120.m: My legs are not as young as yours anymore.
r: You made me fight alone all way here.

dds_dark_priest2_140.m: Are we going to do this now, or are you two going to talk all day?

dds_dark_priest2_150.m: That's its true form! A monster masquerading as a priest! Attack!

r: Borvis? I didn't expect you already.

dds_mourning_woman_260.m: I came with all haste. You were faster.

dds_mourning_woman_262.m: [To the mourning woman] The ritual was not to bring back your husband - it is to bring Kazaul's powerful monsters into Dhayavar.

dds_mourning_woman_270.m: You lie! You don't want my happiness.

dds_mourning_woman_272.m: Do you think monsters would have assisted you? And a barrier would have sprung up? Just for one person?

dds_mourning_woman_282.m: Then why did the ritual not include something that links to your husband?  Something precious to him?

dds_mourning_woman_290.m: Oh no! What do I do now? He's gone.

dds_mourning_woman_292.m: Pray where have you been praying. And tell me who put you up to this?
r: Yes, who put you up to this?

dds_mourning_woman_300.m: Why? That famous miracle priest who walks on lava, west of here. Do you need me anymore? Then I'm going home to mourn again.

dds_mourning_woman_310.m: Yes, you go back to your village. And we will have a chat with this famous miracle priest.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

shadows.10: I met Borvis on the great road near Alynndir's hut.
shadows.20: Since I had told Gandoren about the switch of the weapons, and also the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, he told me to leave.
shadows.30: Since I aided the Shadow once or twice earlier, he requested my further help for an urgent task.
shadows.40: He wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the weird areas to the south of Stoutford.
shadows.50: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford, and encountered an impassable force there.
shadows.60: There were strange glowing, immovable pebbles there. I had to inform Borvis.
shadows.70: Borvis told me that was the basic, but effective, Shadow shield, to protect Shadow incantations from outside interference.
shadows.80: For that, he would give me a chant. But I had to get him energies in the form of four 'blessings' - Shadow's Strength, Shadow Awareness, Fatigue, and Life Drain - within myself. He told me to go to Talion in Loneford for the first blessing, and for information about the others.
shadows.90: Talion bestowed me with Shadow's Strength.
shadows.100: Talion told me to seek out Jolnor in Vilegard for the rest of the 'blessings'.
shadows.110: Jolnor bestowed me with Shadow Awareness.
shadows.120: Jolnor told me to seek Favlon to the west of Sullengard for the remaining two.
shadows.130: I reached Favlon who asked me for 10 Cooked Meat.
shadows.140: I gave Favlon 10 Cooked Meat. He bestowed me with 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain.
shadows.150: After a grueling travel back, I returned to Borvis.
shadows.160: Borvis removed the 'blessings' from me, and made a chant.
shadows.165: Borvis told me to hurry back to the barrier.
shadows.178: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
shadows.180: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
shadows.190: Borvis, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayar with Kazaul's monsters.
shadows.200: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest in the lava wastelands.
shadows.210: We let the mourning woman go.
shadows.212: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
shadows.220: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
shadows.230: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
shadows.240: He accused me of interfering again and again. Borvis, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
shadows.260: Borvis fulfilled his promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his supplies from Alynndir.
shadows.290: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

dds_nd: Darkness in the Daylight and Shadows - Non displayed

dds_nd.20: 20=Told Mikhail about meeting Andor in Miri's or Borvis' quest

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
